summary: The folded admission state carries the acceptance-deliverables refusal while a premise question is open, so the preflight, the work pin, and execution refuse confirm_premise alike; the fresh-review refusal defers to the guards only for accept_worker_result, so every site refuses record_delivery behind review debt; and the late record_verdict route serves a premise-question step that does not declare record_verdict, so frozen ops runbooks at cleanup without a verdict record it there. No definition version changes.
title: The acceptance gate is one admission condition and a missing verdict records late
